---
title: "xcdtc2dt"
---

## Description

Convert character DTC variable into analysis -DT -TM -DTM.

Also creates analysis -DY variable.

## Parameters

**`dtcdate`**

: Name of DTC variable

  *Required:* Yes

**`prefix`**

: Prefix for numeric -DT -TM -DTM -DY analysis variables

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `a`

**`refdate`**

: Reference numeric date

  *Required:* No

## Examples

```sas
%xcdtc2dt(aestdtc,prefix=ast,refdate=trtsdt);
```
